apiKey.previewTooltip: First 7 + last 4 chars; the rest is never read back

body.groq: TalkType will send your recorded audio to Groq (US) for transcription. Groq's policy retains data for up to 14 days. See https://groq.com/privacy
body.openrouter: Audio is sent to Groq for Whisper transcription, then the polish request goes to OpenRouter and its underlying model provider. Both log the request; OpenRouter does not train on prompts by default, but underlying providers vary.
body.nvidia: Audio is sent to Groq for Whisper transcription, then the polish request goes to NVIDIA NIM. NVIDIA does not use prompts for training and retains telemetry around 30 days. See NVIDIA NIM privacy policy.
body.gemini: Audio is sent to Groq for Whisper transcription, then the polish request goes to Google Gemini. Free tier may use submissions to improve models by default; paid tier does not. Confirm tier in Google AI Studio.
body.generic: TalkType will send data to {provider} for processing. See the provider's privacy policy for data retention details.

m5ToM6.title: Upgrade to M6 LLM Polish
m5ToM6.body: M6 adds an LLM polish step with auto-detect default: if you already saved a Groq API key (M3 Whisper), polish is enabled and transcripts are sent to Groq chat completions for cleanup. If you have no LLM provider key set, polish stays off and behavior is unchanged. To opt out, switch the toggle above to OFF. See the per-step data-flow indicator below for the full pipeline.
